title: Manufacturing workspace shows manufacturing sidebar
pre: Org with workspaceType = Manufacturing exists; user can log in.
steps: Log in as the org admin.
expected: Sidebar lists manufacturing sections (Leads, Accounts, Contacts, Opportunities, Activities, RFQs, Site visits, Demos, Products, Costing, Quotations, Approvals, Purchase orders, Sales orders, Dispatch, Payments, Installed assets, AMC, Service, Reports …). EdTech-only items are not shown.

title: Login with valid credentials
expected: User lands on dashboard; JWT issued; logout is available.

title: Login with wrong password
steps: Enter valid email and a wrong password.
expected: Login rejected with a generic error; no session created; no information about which field was wrong.

title: MFA challenge (when enabled)
expected: MFA challenge screen appears after password; correct code grants access, wrong code is rejected.

title: Sales Executive sees only permitted modules
expected: Sales Executive can Create/Read/Update leads, accounts, contacts, activities, opportunities, visits, demos, quotations; read-only on RFQs, products, approvals, POs, orders, dispatch, payments, assets, AMC, service; Reports = read+export. Costing is not visible/accessible.

title: Application Engineer module access
steps: Open RFQs, Site visits, Demos, Opportunities, Costing.
expected: CRU on RFQs, Site visits, Demos, Activities; read-only on Opportunities, Accounts, Contacts, Products, Service, Assets; no access to Costing/Quotations.

title: Commercial / Estimation module access
steps: Open Costing, Quotations, Approvals, Products, POs.
expected: Full CRUD+Export on Costing, Quotations, Approvals, Products; CRU on POs; read on Opportunities, RFQs, Accounts.

title: Operations module access
steps: Open Sales orders, Dispatch, POs, Payments, Costing.
expected: Read+Update on Sales orders and Dispatch; read on POs, Accounts, Products, Assets; no access to Payments or Costing.

title: Accounts role module access
steps: Open Payments, Sales orders, POs, Dispatch, Leads.
expected: Read/Update/Export on Payments; read on Sales orders, POs, Accounts, Dispatch; Reports read+export; no access to Leads.

title: Service roles module access
steps: Open Service, Assets, AMC, Accounts, Opportunities.
expected: Read+Update on Service tickets; read on Assets, AMC, Accounts; no access to Opportunities. Service Manager additionally has full CRUD+Export on Service/Assets/AMC.

title: Record access: Own vs Team vs All
pre: Two Sales Executives (A, B) under one Manager each own leads/opps.
steps: Log in as A; list leads and opportunities.
expected: A sees only own records; Manager sees team records; Director/Super Admin sees all records of the org.

title: Direct URL to a restricted module
steps: Manually type the URL of Costing (/costing) or its detail page.
expected: Restricted-module access banner/403 is shown; no cost data is displayed.

title: Detail pages show 360° tabs
pre: Account and Opportunity with related data exist.
expected: Account tabs: Overview, Plants, Contacts, Opportunities, Quotations, Orders, Installed assets, Service, Payments, Activities. Opportunity tabs: Overview, Stage history, Contacts, Activities, Requirements, Visits, Demos & trials, Costing, Quotations, PO / Orders. Each tab loads related records without error.

title: Logout and token expiry
steps: Press browser Back / call an API with the old token.
expected: Session ends; protected pages redirect to login; old token is rejected (401).

title: Forgot / reset password
steps: Open the emailed link and set a new password.
expected: Reset email delivered; link works once; new password accepted; old password stops working.

title: Create a lead with all mandatory fields
steps: Fill company, contact name, phone, email, product, source, city/state, estimated value, next action + date.
expected: Lead created with status 'New', owner = creator, createdAt set. SLA-01 'Lead first response' timer starts. Lead appears in list.

title: Create lead with missing mandatory fields
expected: Form blocks save with field-level validation messages; nothing is created.

title: All 14 lead sources selectable
steps: Open New lead and open the Source dropdown.
expected: Dropdown lists: Website, Google Ads, Meta, IndiaMART, TradeIndia, Exhibition, Referral, LinkedIn, WhatsApp, Email, Dealer, Cold calling, Existing customer, Manual / API. Dropdown scrolls and does not overflow the dialog.

title: Duplicate phone/email/company on lead creation
pre: Lead exists with phone 9876543210, email buyer@shreesteel.in, company 'Shree Steel Pvt Ltd'.
steps: Create another lead with the same phone (or email, or company name).
expected: Spec: system warns before save and offers link/merge path (§37 'Lead duplicate'). Flow chart: 'Duplicate → Merge existing lead'.
verificationNote: The create form does warn: on blur it searches the list for the first filled duplicate key (leads: phone, email, company) and shows 'A matching lead already exists. Open existing'. It does not block saving and there is no merge; the backend still creates the duplicate (live API: two leads, 201/201). So: UI warning + link = built; server-side enforcement and merge = missing.
note: Code review: MfgLeadsService.create() has no dedupe; duplicate checks exist only at conversion (account name/GSTIN, contact phone/email). Log as defect if a second record is silently created.

title: Lead owner assignment (manual)
pre: Manager logged in; team members exist.
steps: Create lead and choose another owner.
expected: Owner saved; lead visible to the assigned owner; creator-role without cross-owner permission is forced to own the lead.

title: Automatic assignment (round-robin / territory / product / industry)
pre: Assignment rule configured (if any) for Manufacturing leads.
steps: Create several leads without choosing an owner.
expected: Spec: leads auto-assigned by configured rule. Flow chart: 'Assigned · 1h SLA'.
verificationNote: A lead created without ownerId was owned by the caller; MfgLeadsService has no assignment-rule code.
note: Manufacturing leads currently default owner to the creator; rule-based assignment found only in the EdTech assignments module. Verify and record.

title: Mark contacted (New → Contacted)
expected: Status = Contacted; SLA-01 first-response timer stops; SLA-02 'Qualification decision' timer starts.

title: Mark contacted from invalid status
expected: Rejected: "Cannot Mark contacted a lead in status 'Qualified'." Status unchanged.

title: Qualify a lead (Contacted → Qualified)
pre: Lead in status Contacted (also test Follow-up and Nurture).
expected: Status = Qualified; 'Convert to opportunity' button becomes available; SLA-02 timer stops.

title: BANT captured before Qualified
pre: Lead in Contacted with empty Qualification section.
steps: Open Qualification tab; leave Budget/Authority/Need/Timeline empty.
expected: Spec/flow: Budget, Authority, Need, Timeline must be captured before Qualified.
note: Qualification tab exists, but the Qualify action has no required-field guard in code. Confirm whether the UI enforces it; otherwise log as gap.

title: Move to nurture (Contacted/Follow-up → Nurture)
expected: Status = Nurture; lead can later be re-qualified (Nurture → Qualified). Not allowed from New/Assigned/Qualified.

title: Disqualify with reason
expected: Status = Disqualified; reason stored; lead removed from active views.

title: Disqualify without reason is blocked
steps: Click Disqualify and submit with empty reason.
expected: Rejected: "'disq' is required to Disqualify." (UI should require the reason field). Status unchanged.

title: Disqualify an already Qualified lead
expected: Rejected: Disqualify only allowed from New, Assigned, Contacted, Follow-up, Nurture.

title: Convert qualified lead → new Account + Contact + Opportunity
pre: Lead Qualified; company not present in Accounts.
steps: Choose 'Create new account'; select type, industry, territory, GSTIN.
expected: Account, Contact and Opportunity (stage 'Qualified', 10%) created in one transaction; opportunity title '<Company> — <Product>'; close date ≈ +90 days; next action 'Follow up after conversion' ≈ +7 days; lead status = Converted; all records linked; owner carried over.

title: Convert requires contact buying role
steps: Start conversion; leave buying role empty; confirm.
expected: Rejected: "'contactRole' is required to convert a lead."

title: Convert requires account type/industry/territory for new account
steps: Choose 'new account' but leave industry/territory blank; confirm.
expected: Rejected with message naming account.type, account.industry and account.territory as required.

title: Convert when account already exists (name match)
pre: Account 'Shree Steel Pvt. Ltd.' exists. Lead company 'Shree Steel Private Limited'.
expected: No duplicate account created. Response flags duplicate and returns existing account; UI shows 'Open existing' / link option. Name normalisation ignores Pvt/Ltd/LLP/Inc/Corp and punctuation.

title: Convert when GSTIN already exists
pre: Account with GSTIN 27AABCS1234A1Z5 exists under a different name.
steps: Convert lead with new account using the same GSTIN.
expected: Duplicate flagged by GSTIN; no new account created.

title: Convert onto an existing account — contact duplicate
pre: Account exists and has a contact with the lead's phone/email.
steps: Convert choosing the existing account (no contactId).
expected: Duplicate contact flagged (existingContactId returned); no second contact created.

title: Convert onto existing account linking an existing contact
steps: Convert; pick existing account and contact C1.
expected: Opportunity linked to C1; no new contact; lead = Converted.

title: Convert a non-Qualified lead
expected: Rejected: "Lead must be Qualified before it can be converted (current status: 'Contacted')." Button hidden in UI.

title: First-response SLA shows state in list
pre: Lead created; business-hours calendar configured; SLA-01 target 1 hour.
steps: Create lead; view Response SLA column immediately.
Wait past target (or use a short test target) without contacting.
expected: SLA column shows remaining time; after breach it shows red 'breached'; escalation notification is sent per escalation levels.

title: SLA-01 target picks source/value bracket
pre: SLA-01 has targets for 'Source = IndiaMART or Google Ads' and 'Estimated value ≥ ₹50 L'.
steps: Create lead with source IndiaMART; create another with value ₹60,00,000.
expected: Each lead's SLA uses the matching tighter target rather than the default.

title: Archive (soft-delete) a lead
pre: Lead exists; user has Delete permission.
expected: Lead disappears from lists but remains in DB (isDeleted = true); not hard-deleted.

title: Sales Executive cannot see another rep's leads
pre: Leads owned by rep A and rep B.
steps: Log in as A; open list; open B's lead URL directly.
expected: A sees only own leads; B's lead returns 'not found'.

title: Lead list search, filter by status/owner, sort, pagination
expected: Results match the criteria; server-side pagination works; total count correct.

title: Webhook/website lead received twice
steps: Submit the same payload (same external id) twice.
expected: Spec: no duplicate lead created.
note: Dedup for the generic CRM leads exists; confirm the same rule applies to Manufacturing leads fed by integrations.

title: Create account with GSTIN
steps: Enter legal name, GSTIN, type, industry, territory, city, state.
expected: Account created with status Active, owner = creator; appears in list.

title: Account mandatory fields
steps: Open New account; save with blank name/type/industry/territory.
expected: Validation errors; no record created.

title: Duplicate account (name / GSTIN) on manual create
ref: §4 Duplicate detection / Flow: Block + link existing
pre: Account 'Shree Steel Pvt Ltd' with GSTIN exists.
steps: Create another account with the same GSTIN or same normalised name.
expected: Spec: flag duplicate before save and link to existing. Flow: 'Duplicate GSTIN / name → Block + link existing'.
verificationNote: The account form warns on blur using dupKeys name + gstin ('A matching account already exists. Open existing'); it does not block saving and the backend does not enforce uniqueness on manual create.
note: Dedupe is implemented in lead conversion; verify the manual New-account form also blocks. Log defect if both are created.

title: Add multiple plants to one account
steps: Add Plant 1 and Plant 2 with address/territory/type.
expected: Both plants listed under the account; each has its own address.

title: Mark account Dormant and Reactivate
expected: Active → Dormant → Active. 'Mark dormant' is allowed from Active/On hold only; 'Reactivate' from Dormant/On hold only (else "Cannot … an account in status …").

title: Reassign account owner
expected: Owner changes to B; B now sees the account; A (own-only role) no longer does.
note: Reassign is a plain ownerId update; spec requires audit history of the change — verify audit entry exists.

title: Account 360° tabs show linked records
pre: Account with contacts, opps, quotes, orders, assets, tickets, payments.
steps: Open each tab on the account.
expected: Each tab lists only records of that account; counts consistent with module lists.

title: Search account by GSTIN / name / city
steps: Use list search for partial name, GSTIN, city.
expected: Matching accounts returned.

title: Create contact with buying role
steps: Select account, plant, name, designation, phone, WhatsApp, email.
expected: Contact saved and visible on the account's Contacts tab.

title: Buying role list is complete
expected: Decision Maker, Technical Influencer, User, Procurement, Finance, Gatekeeper, Management.

title: Duplicate contact (phone/email) on same account
steps: Create another contact on the same account with the same phone.
expected: Spec: duplicate flagged before save.
verificationNote: The contact form warns on blur using dupKeys phone + email (list search, not scoped to the same account); it does not block saving.
note: Confirm manual-create duplicate warning; conversion path is covered by LEAD cases.

title: Contact linked to a plant of the same account
expected: Contact shows plant; only plants of the chosen account are offered.

title: Deactivate a contact
expected: Contact remains in history but is not offered for new transactions.
note: Verify filtering of inactive contacts in dropdowns.

title: Create opportunity manually
steps: Select account, contact, product, value, close date, source, next action and next action date.
expected: Opportunity created at stage 'Qualified' (10%); owner = creator; currency INR default.

title: Opportunity requires Next Action and Date
steps: Create opportunity without next action / date.
expected: Save blocked: next action and next action date are mandatory on every open opportunity.

title: Stage update without next action
steps: Change stage (edit form or Advance stage) and clear next action/date.
expected: Rejected: "'nextAction' and 'nextActionDate' are required when updating an active opportunity's stage."

title: Advance stage through the pipeline
steps: Use 'Advance stage' repeatedly through Requirement collected → … → Costing → Quotation sent → Negotiation.
expected: Each change writes an immutable history row (from → to, user, timestamp); days-in-stage resets; probability follows the stages master (10/15/20/25/30/40/45/50/60/65/80/95%).

title: Age and days-in-stage values
pre: Opportunity created some days ago and stage changed later.
expected: Age = whole days since creation; days in stage = days since latest stage change.

title: Cannot set Won/Lost by editing the stage field
steps: Edit opportunity and set stage = Won (or Lost) directly.
expected: Rejected: "Use the 'Mark won'/'Mark lost' actions … to move an opportunity to 'Won'."

title: Mark lost with mandatory reason
pre: Open opportunity in any pre-PO stage.
expected: Stage = Lost; reason stored; history row added; removed from active pipeline but retained for analytics.

title: Mark lost without reason
expected: Rejected: "'lost' is required to Mark lost."

title: Lost-reason list
expected: Price, Competitor, Technical mismatch, Delivery time, Budget, Project cancelled, No response, Existing vendor, Payment terms, Internal approval, Other.

title: Mark won from allowed stages only
pre: Opportunities in Negotiation / PO expected / PO received and one in Qualified.
expected: Allowed from Negotiation, PO expected, PO received; refused from Qualified: "Cannot Mark won an opportunity in stage 'Qualified'."

title: Actions on Won/Lost opportunity
expected: Further transitions refused; Advance stage hidden for Won/Lost/PO received.

title: Multiple quotations and products per opportunity
steps: Create two quotations under the same opportunity.
expected: Both appear in the Quotations tab; opportunity value is independent of quotation value.

title: Stagnation SLA (SLA-03/04) on stage entry
steps: Move a deal to a new stage.
Check SLA state; leave it past the target.
expected: Stage-stagnation timer restarts on each stage change; breach alerts owner; high-value (≥ ₹1 Cr) deals escalate to manager (SLA-04).

title: Expected close date crossed alert
pre: Opportunity with close date in the past.
steps: Wait for / trigger the SLA sweep.
expected: Owner alert generated; entry visible in notification bell.
note: Date-triggered sweep exists for several SLAs; confirm a close-date policy exists.

title: Log activity from the opportunity
steps: Click 'Log activity'; fill type, subject, outcome; save.
expected: Activity linked to the opportunity and visible in Activities tab and timeline.

title: Hierarchy scoping on opportunities
pre: Opps owned by A and B.
steps: Log in as A; list and open B's opportunity by URL.
expected: Only A's opportunities visible; B's returns not found.

title: Create an activity (task) linked to an opportunity
steps: Select type Call, subject, due date, link opportunity.
expected: Activity created with status Open; owner = creator (Sales Executive cannot assign others).

title: Activity type list
expected: Call, WhatsApp, Email, Meeting, Site visit, Demo, Quotation follow-up, PO follow-up, Payment follow-up, Service follow-up.

title: Complete activity with outcome
expected: Status = Completed; outcome stored; SLA-06 stops; linked opportunity's SLA-05 'Next action overdue' also stops.

title: Complete activity without outcome
expected: Rejected: "'outcome' is required to Complete."

title: Cancel an activity; complete a cancelled one
expected: Cancel allowed from Open only; Complete afterwards is rejected: "Cannot Complete an activity in status 'Cancelled'."

title: Activity linked to lead/contact/account
expected: Each appears on the corresponding record's Activities tab; links to other-org records are rejected.

title: Overdue follow-up shows red
pre: Open activity with due date in the past.
steps: Open Activities list and dashboard 'Overdue follow-ups'.
expected: Item flagged red/overdue; appears in the salesperson dashboard overdue list.

title: Overdue high-priority task escalates (SLA-06)
steps: Create High-priority activity due now; let it age past target.
expected: Owner notified, then manager per escalation levels; breach logged.

title: Unified timeline on Account / Opportunity
pre: Activities, visits and stage changes exist.
steps: Open the Activities tab of an opportunity and account.
expected: Chronological list of interactions with owner, type, outcome.
note: Activities tab is a related list; verify visits/demos/quotation events also appear if expected.

title: Create an RFQ for an opportunity
steps: Select opportunity; enter customer RFQ no., application, product, quantity, capacity, specs.
expected: RFQ created with status 'Received', revision 1; SLA-07 'Technical feasibility response' starts.

title: Mark feasible → Approve for costing
expected: Received → Technically feasible → Approved for costing; SLA-07 stops on the first decision; costing sheet can now be created (SLA-10 starts).

title: Approve for costing directly from Received
expected: Rejected: "Cannot Approve for costing an RFQ in status 'Received'." (only from Technically feasible).

title: Request clarification with note
expected: Status = Clarification required; note saved; sales owner notified.

title: Clarification without note
expected: Rejected: "'clarification' is required to Request clarification."

title: Mark Not feasible with reason
expected: Status = Not feasible; reason stored. Blank reason is rejected ("'nf' is required…").

title: Create new revision of an RFQ
expected: Revision number increments; previous revision retained and viewable; history preserved.

title: Attach RFQ documents/drawings
expected: Files stored and downloadable via short-lived signed URLs; type/size limits enforced.
note: Verify attachment support on the RFQ form; spec lists RFQ/BOQ/drawing/layout/photos/datasheet.

title: Costing gated by technical feasibility
pre: RFQ not yet Approved for costing.
steps: Try to create/submit costing for the opportunity.
expected: Spec: costing/quotation should be gated until RFQ is Approved for costing.
note: Costing create only validates opportunity; confirm if UI/ rule blocks it.

title: Sales notified on clarification requested/completed
steps: Check notification bell as sales owner.
expected: In-app notification appears for the sales owner.
note: Confirm notifications are wired for RFQ events.

title: Schedule a site visit
steps: Select opportunity, account/plant, date-time, engineer, objective.
expected: Visit created with status Planned.

title: Confirm visit
expected: Status = Confirmed.

title: Reschedule requires new date
expected: Without date: "'date' is required to Reschedule." With date: status Rescheduled and date updated; can be Confirmed again.

title: Complete visit requires next action
steps: Click 'Complete visit' with no next action.
expected: Rejected: "'next' is required to Complete visit."

title: Complete visit with findings and next action
steps: Enter observations, recommended solution, next action; Complete visit.
expected: Status = Completed; visit appears in opportunity timeline; SLA-08 'report submission' starts.

title: Download Site Visit Report PDF
expected: A real PDF downloads containing account, plant, date, engineers, objective, findings, recommendation, next action. Button only appears for Completed visits.

title: Cancel a visit
expected: Status = Cancelled; cannot be completed afterwards.

title: Complete a Cancelled/Completed visit
expected: Rejected: "Cannot Complete visit a site visit in status 'Cancelled'."

title: Visit reminder before scheduled time
expected: Reminder notification generated.
verificationNote: The SLA date-sweep rules cover opportunities, activities, quotations, sales orders, coverage and payments only; nothing is scheduled for site visits.
note: No visit-reminder policy found among the 22 default SLA policies; verify.

title: Attach photographs to visit
expected: Photos stored and viewable.
note: Verify attachment UI on visit form.

title: Request a demo/trial
steps: Demos → New; select opportunity, type, product/sample, planned date.
expected: Evaluation created with status 'Requested'.

title: Schedule → Start → Mark successful
expected: Requested → Scheduled → In progress → Successful; SLA-09 'Evaluation result' starts at Start and stops when result recorded.

title: Start before Schedule
expected: Rejected: "Cannot Start an evaluation in status 'Requested'."

title: Mark failed requires result
expected: Rejected: "'result' is required to Mark failed." With result: status Failed.

title: Customer approved / rejected
expected: Status = Customer approved (only from Successful); Customer rejected allowed from Successful/Completed.

title: Successful trial prompts move to Solution proposed
ref: §11 Hand-off / Flow: Success prompts Solution proposed
expected: User is prompted (or can easily move) the opportunity to 'Solution proposed' (40%).
note: Confirm a prompt exists in UI; stage move itself is manual via Advance stage.

title: Sample logistics fields
steps: Fill dispatch/delivery/test dates on Sample logistics tab.
expected: Dates stored and shown.

title: Evaluation overdue reminder
expected: Owner reminder generated.
note: SLA-09 covers result time only; confirm overdue-planned reminder.

title: Create product with SKU, price, tax, lead time
steps: Enter category, family, model, SKU, price, HSN, GST rate, lead time, warranty months.
expected: Product saved; visible in list and in quotation product pickers.

title: Category → Family → Model → SKU
steps: Create products across categories (Weighbridges, Belt weighers, Checkweighers, Bagging & packing, Conveyors, Components, Services).
expected: Hierarchy reflected in list filters and detail.

title: Specification attributes tab
expected: Attributes saved per product (ProductAttribute) and shown on the tab.

title: Standard cost / minimum price restricted
pre: Field-security default: Standard cost & Minimum selling price restricted to roles other than Super Admin, Director, Sales Head, Commercial.
steps: Log in as Sales Executive; open product list/detail and call the product API/export.
expected: Standard cost and minimum price are absent from UI, API response and exports.

title: Inactive product unavailable for new quotes
steps: Create a quotation line; open product picker.
Open an old quotation containing the product.
expected: Inactive product not selectable for new transactions; still visible on historical records.
note: Verify picker filters inactive products.

title: Archive product
expected: Soft-deleted; historical quotations unaffected.

title: Create a costing sheet
pre: Opportunity exists; RFQ approved for costing.
steps: Select opportunity; enter material, bought-out, fabrication, electrical, software, labour, installation, freight, packing, travel, overhead, contingency, other costs and selling price.
expected: Sheet created in Draft, revision 0/1; SLA-10 'Costing preparation' starts (target 3 business days).

title: Total cost, gross margin and margin % computed correctly
pre: Sheet with costs: material 400000, bought-out 100000, fabrication 150000, labour 50000, other 0; selling price 1000000.
expected: Total cost = 700000; Gross margin = 300000; Margin % = 30.00. Breakdown tab lists every component with value.

title: Zero selling price does not divide by zero
expected: No crash; margin % reported as 0.

title: Submit with margin ≥ 20% (no rule matches high band)
pre: Default Margin rules: 15–20% → Sales Head; 0–15% → Director.
expected: Rule lookup uses last band for value above max; verify outcome per configured rules — document whether sheet becomes 'Approval pending' or 'Approved'.
verificationNote: 30% margin gave 'Approval pending' routed to Sales Head (the top band). 12% margin went to Director; 17% to Sales Head.
note: findMatchingApprovalRule returns the highest band when value ≥ max, so 30% still routes to the top band (Sales Head). Confirm this is the intended business behaviour.

title: Submit with low margin routes to approver
expected: Sheet → 'Approval pending'; an Approval record (type Margin, status Requested, approver Director) is created; SLA-14 starts.

title: Submit with margin in 15–20% band
expected: Approval created for 'Sales Head'; reason text 'GM% 17.00 matched rule …'.

title: Submit when no margin rules configured
expected: Sheet auto-moves to 'Approved' with no approval record.

title: Submit from non-Draft
expected: Rejected: "Cannot submit a costing sheet in status 'Approval pending'."

title: Approve and reject costing
expected: Approve → Approved, approvedBy = current user. Reject requires reason ("'rej' is required to Reject.") → Rejected. Rejected sheet can be Submitted again (button shows for Draft/Rejected).

title: New costing revision
expected: Sheet returns to Draft; revision number +1; editing re-enabled. On a sheet already in Draft: "Costing sheet … is already in Draft."

title: Costing hidden from Sales Executive
steps: Call GET /costing API; open quotation detail.
expected: Costing module returns 'Costing is restricted.' (403); no cost/margin appears in any UI screen, API response, PDF or export.

title: Quotation PDF does not expose cost
expected: PDF contains only customer pricing; no cost, margin or costing references.

title: Costing linked to opportunity and account scoped to org
steps: Create costing with a foreign opportunity id (API).
expected: Rejected: "Opportunity '…' not found in your organization."

title: Create quotation with line items
steps: Select opportunity; set validity date, payment terms, delivery terms.
Add lines (product, qty, unit price, discount %).
expected: Quotation V1 created in Draft; line amounts = qty × price × (1 − discount%); defaults for tax/warranty/lead time pre-filled from product.
note: Verify default population from product master in UI.

title: Edit lines only while Draft
expected: Rejected: "Quotation lines can only be edited while the quotation is in Draft (current status: '…')."

title: Submit for approval — no rule matches (discount ≤ 5%)
pre: Lines with max discount 3%. Default Discount rules.
expected: Status → Approved or Approval pending per rule lookup (0–5% band approver 'Salesperson'); verify which one occurs and that SLA-11 'Quotation issue' starts when Approved.
verificationNote: With the default rules even 0% and 3% discounts create a Discount approval (approver 'Salesperson') and the quotation goes to 'Approval pending'. It only auto-approves when no rules exist.
note: Default 0–5% band is configured as an approval rule, so a record may still be created; record actual behaviour.

title: Discount 5–10% routes to Sales Manager
steps: Add a line with 8% discount; Submit for approval.
expected: Quotation → 'Approval pending'; Approval (type Discount, approver Sales Manager, status Requested) created; reason 'Discount 8% matched rule …'.

title: Discount 10–15% routes to Sales Head; >15% to Director
expected: 12% → Sales Head; 20% → Director.
verificationNote: 12% went to Sales Head and 20% to Director. 5% and 8% went to Sales Manager.

title: Highest line discount drives the rule
expected: Rule chosen for 11% (maximum across lines).

title: Warning when price below minimum selling price
pre: Product minimum price ₹100,000; line unit price ₹110,000 with 12% discount (net ₹96,800).
expected: Submission response carries warning: 'Line for <SKU> is priced below minimum (₹96800.00 < ₹100000)'; UI shows the warning.
verificationNote: 12% on ₹10 L (min ₹9 L) returned the warning 'Line for … is priced below minimum (₹880000.00 < ₹900000)'.

title: Cannot mark Sent while approval pending
expected: Rejected: "Cannot Mark sent a quotation in status 'Approval pending'." Only Approved quotations can be Sent.
verificationNote: Mark sent on an Approval-pending quotation returned 400 "Cannot Mark sent a quotation in status 'Approval pending'."

title: Approve quotation then mark sent
expected: Approved → Sent; SLA-11 stops and SLA-12 'Quotation follow-up' starts (3 days); follow-up task expected.
note: Spec requires an auto follow-up task on Sent; SLA timer exists — confirm an Activity is also created.

title: Reject quotation approval returns to Draft
expected: Quotation returns to Draft; reason required ("'rej' is required to Reject."); lines editable again.

title: Revise creates V2; V1 untouched
expected: V2 created in Draft with parentId = V1, lines copied, same terms; V1 status = Revised and read-only; navigation goes to V2; Versions tab shows chain.

title: Revise from invalid statuses
expected: Allowed only from Sent, Approved, Rejected, Approval pending; others rejected: "Cannot revise a quotation in status '…'." (button hidden in UI).

title: Mark accepted / rejected

title: Happy path: Lead → Cash → Warranty → Renewal
pre: Org seeded; users for each role; product 'Truck Weighbridge 60T' with minimum price.
steps: Sales Exec creates lead (source IndiaMART) → contacted → qualified.
Convert to opportunity (new account, GSTIN, contact role Decision Maker).
App Engineer logs RFQ → feasible → approve for costing; schedules and completes site visit; demo successful → customer approved.
Sales creates quotation with 8% discount → submit → manager approves → Mark sent.
Customer accepts → create PO (30/60/10 terms) → verify → Accept PO.
Operations acknowledges handover and advances status to Commissioned with serial.
Create dispatch → delivered; Accounts records receipts for all milestones.
Service Manager creates AMC; reminders; create renewal opportunity; raise service ticket and close it.
expected: Every step succeeds; records are linked end-to-end (lead → account/contact/opportunity → RFQ/visit/demo → costing → quotation V1 → approval → PO → order → dispatch → milestones/receipts → asset → AMC → renewal opportunity → ticket). Dashboards and reports reflect the transactions.

title: Lead duplicate → link/merge path
expected: Warning and link/merge option.
verificationNote: The create form does warn: on blur it searches the list for the first filled duplicate key (leads: phone, email, company) and shows 'A matching lead already exists. Open existing'. It does not block saving and there is no merge; the backend still creates the duplicate (live API: two leads, 201/201). So: UI warning + link = built; server-side enforcement and merge = missing.
note: See LEAD duplicate case.
